title.en: A new insulin pump program for adults with type 1 diabetes
title.es: Un nuevo programa de bomba de insulina para adultos con diabetes tipo 1

summary.en: This study tests an automatic insulin pump that adjusts your dose for you. It is only for type 1 diabetes. You would wear the pump for 6 months.
summary.es: Este estudio prueba una bomba de insulina automática que ajusta su dosis por usted. Es solo para diabetes tipo 1. Usaría la bomba durante 6 meses.

checks.sourceText: Age 18 to 75 years

plain.en: You are 18 to 75 years old.

checks.sourceText: Clinical diagnosis of type 1 diabetes for at least 1 year

plain.en: You have type 1 diabetes.

checks.sourceText: Diagnosis of type 2 diabetes, monogenic diabetes, or secondary diabetes

plain.en: You cannot join if you have type 2 diabetes.
plain.es: No puede participar si tiene diabetes tipo 2.

checks.sourceText: Currently using insulin by multiple daily injections or pump

plain.en: You use insulin now.

checks.sourceText: Pregnant or lactating, or planning pregnancy during the study

plain.en: You are not pregnant or breastfeeding.

checks.sourceText: HbA1c between 6.5% and 11.0% at screening

plain.en: Your HbA1c (3-month blood sugar test) is 6.5% to 11%.
plain.es: Su HbA1c (prueba de azúcar de 3 meses) está entre 6.5% y 11%.

title.en: A once-a-week shot to lower blood sugar in type 2 diabetes
title.es: Una inyección semanal para bajar el azúcar en la sangre en la diabetes tipo 2
title.pt: Uma injeção semanal para baixar o açúcar no sangue no diabetes tipo 2
title.ht: Yon piki chak semèn pou bese sik nan san nan dyabèt tip 2
title.zh: 每周一次注射，降低2型糖尿病患者的血糖
title.vi: Mũi tiêm mỗi tuần một lần để hạ đường huyết ở bệnh tiểu đường loại 2

summary.en: This study tests a new weekly shot for people with type 2 diabetes who already take metformin. Some people get the new medicine and some get a shot with no medicine. The study lasts about 1 year.
summary.es: Este estudio prueba una nueva inyección semanal para personas con diabetes tipo 2 que ya toman metformina. Algunas personas reciben el nuevo medicamento y otras una inyección sin medicamento. El estudio dura aproximadamente 1 año.
summary.pt: Este estudo testa uma nova injeção semanal para pessoas com diabetes tipo 2 que já tomam metformina. Algumas pessoas recebem o novo remédio e outras uma injeção sem remédio. O estudo dura cerca de 1 ano.
summary.ht: Etid sa a teste yon nouvo piki chak semèn pou moun ki gen dyabèt tip 2 ki deja pran metfòmin. Gen moun ki resevwa nouvo medikaman an, gen lòt ki resevwa yon piki san medikaman. Etid la dire anviwon 1 an.
summary.zh: 本研究测试一种新的每周注射药物，适用于已在服用二甲双胍的2型糖尿病患者。部分人会使用新药，部分人会使用不含药物的注射剂。研究持续约1年。
summary.vi: Nghiên cứu này thử nghiệm một mũi tiêm mới hằng tuần cho người bị tiểu đường loại 2 đang dùng metformin. Một số người nhận thuốc mới, một số người nhận mũi tiêm không có thuốc. Nghiên cứu kéo dài khoảng 1 năm.

checks.sourceText: Age 40 to 80 years

plain.en: You are 40 to 80 years old.

checks.sourceText: Diagnosed with type 2 diabetes mellitus at least 180 days before screening

plain.en: You have type 2 diabetes.

checks.sourceText: Stable daily dose of metformin (≥1500 mg or maximum tolerated dose) for at least 90 days

plain.en: You take metformin every day.
plain.pt: Você toma metformina todos os dias.

checks.sourceText: Treatment with insulin or any GLP-1 receptor agonist within 90 days before screening

plain.en: You have not used insulin or a GLP-1 shot in the last 90 days.
plain.es: No ha usado insulina ni una inyección GLP-1 en los últimos 90 días.
plain.pt: Você não usou insulina nem injeção de GLP-1 nos últimos 90 dias.
plain.ht: Ou pa sèvi ak ensilin oswa piki GLP-1 nan 90 dènye jou yo.
plain.zh: 您在过去90天内未使用胰岛素或GLP-1注射剂。
plain.vi: Bạn chưa dùng insulin hay thuốc tiêm GLP-1 trong 90 ngày qua.

checks.sourceText: History of acute or chronic pancreatitis

plain.en: You have never had pancreatitis.
plain.vi: Bạn chưa từng bị viêm tụy.

checks.sourceText: Personal or family history of medullary thyroid carcinoma or Multiple Endocrine Neoplasia syndrome type 2

plain.en: No one in your family has had a rare thyroid cancer (MTC or MEN2).
plain.es: Nadie en su familia ha tenido un cáncer de tiroides raro (MTC o MEN2).
plain.pt: Ninguém na sua família teve um câncer de tireoide raro (MTC ou MEN2).
plain.ht: Pèsonn nan fanmi ou pa t janm gen yon kansè tiwoyid ki ra (MTC oswa MEN2).
plain.zh: 您的家人中没有人患过罕见甲状腺癌（MTC或MEN2）。
plain.vi: Không ai trong gia đình bạn từng bị ung thư tuyến giáp hiếm gặp (MTC hoặc MEN2).

checks.sourceText: Female who is pregnant, breast-feeding or intends to become pregnant

plain.en: You are not pregnant or breastfeeding.
plain.pt: Você não está grávida nem amamentando.
plain.ht: Ou pa ansent epi ou pa bay tete.
plain.vi: Bạn không mang thai hoặc cho con bú.

checks.sourceText: HbA1c 7.0-10.5% (both inclusive) at screening

plain.en: Your HbA1c (3-month blood sugar test) is 7% to 10.5%.
plain.es: Su HbA1c (prueba de azúcar de 3 meses) está entre 7% y 10.5%.
plain.pt: Seu HbA1c (exame de açúcar de 3 meses) está entre 7% e 10,5%.
plain.ht: HbA1c ou (tès sik 3 mwa) ant 7% ak 10.5%.
plain.zh: 您的糖化血红蛋白（3个月血糖检测）在7%至10.5%之间。
plain.vi: Chỉ số HbA1c (xét nghiệm đường huyết 3 tháng) của bạn từ 7% đến 10,5%.

checks.sourceText: eGFR <30 mL/min/1.73 m2

plain.en: Your kidneys work well enough (eGFR 30 or higher).
plain.es: Sus riñones funcionan lo suficiente (eGFR de 30 o más).
plain.pt: Seus rins funcionam bem o suficiente (eGFR 30 ou mais).
plain.ht: Ren ou travay ase byen (eGFR 30 oswa plis).
plain.zh: 您的肾功能足够好（eGFR为30或以上）。
plain.vi: Thận của bạn hoạt động đủ tốt (eGFR từ 30 trở lên).

title.en: Healthy eating and walking program for people with diabetes or high weight
title.es: Programa de alimentación sana y caminatas para personas con diabetes o peso alto
title.pt: Programa de alimentação saudável e caminhada para pessoas com diabetes ou peso alto

summary.en: This study tests a 6-month coaching program on food and walking, held at community health centers. There is no new medicine. Healthy adults can also join.
summary.es: Este estudio prueba un programa de 6 meses de apoyo sobre comida y caminatas en centros de salud comunitarios. No hay medicamento nuevo. También pueden participar adultos sanos.
summary.pt: Este estudo testa um programa de 6 meses de orientação sobre alimentação e caminhada em centros de saúde comunitários. Não há remédio novo. Adultos saudáveis também podem participar.

checks.sourceText: Adults 21 years or older

plain.en: You are 21 or older.

checks.sourceText: Unable to walk unassisted for at least 6 minutes

plain.en: You can walk on your own for 6 minutes.
plain.pt: Você consegue caminhar sozinho por 6 minutos.

checks.sourceText: Myocardial infarction or stroke within the past 6 months

plain.en: You have not had a heart attack or stroke in the last 6 months.
plain.es: No ha tenido un ataque al corazón o derrame en los últimos 6 meses.
plain.pt: Você não teve infarto ou AVC nos últimos 6 meses.

checks.sourceText: Willing to attend at least 75% of sessions per protocol section 6.2

plain.en: Ask the study team about how many sessions you must attend.
plain.es: Pregunte al equipo del estudio cuántas sesiones debe asistir.
plain.pt: Pergunte à equipe do estudo quantas sessões você precisa frequentar.

title.en: A pill to help people with heart failure feel better and stay out of the hospital
title.es: Una pastilla para ayudar a las personas con insuficiencia cardíaca a sentirse mejor y evitar el hospital

summary.en: This study tests whether a new daily pill helps people with heart failure. You keep your usual heart medicines. The study lasts about 18 months.
summary.es: Este estudio prueba si una nueva pastilla diaria ayuda a las personas con insuficiencia cardíaca. Usted sigue con sus medicamentos habituales para el corazón. El estudio dura unos 18 meses.

checks.sourceText: Age ≥18 years

plain.en: You are 18 or older.

checks.sourceText: Documented diagnosis of chronic heart failure (NYHA class II-IV)

plain.en: You have heart failure.

checks.sourceText: LVEF ≤40% within the past 12 months

plain.en: Your heart pumping strength (ejection fraction) is 40% or less.
plain.es: La fuerza de bombeo de su corazón (fracción de eyección) es de 40% o menos.

checks.sourceText: Acute coronary syndrome, stroke or TIA within 6 months prior to enrollment

plain.en: You have not had a heart attack or stroke in the last 6 months.
plain.es: No ha tenido un ataque al corazón o derrame en los últimos 6 meses.

checks.sourceText: Participation in another interventional drug trial within 30 days

plain.en: You have not been in another drug study in the last 30 days.
plain.es: No ha estado en otro estudio de medicamentos en los últimos 30 días.

title.en: A new targeted medicine for advanced breast cancer
title.es: Un nuevo medicamento dirigido para el cáncer de mama avanzado

summary.en: This early study tests a new medicine for breast cancer that has spread. The goal is to find a safe dose. Everyone in the study gets the new medicine.
summary.es: Este estudio inicial prueba un nuevo medicamento para el cáncer de mama que se ha extendido. El objetivo es encontrar una dosis segura. Todas las personas del estudio reciben el nuevo medicamento.

checks.sourceText: Age ≥ 18 years

plain.en: You are 18 or older.

checks.sourceText: Female participants

plain.en: This study is for women.

checks.sourceText: Histologically confirmed HR+/HER2- metastatic breast cancer

plain.en: You have breast cancer that has spread.
plain.es: Tiene cáncer de mama que se ha extendido.

checks.sourceText: Prior anti-PD-1/PD-L1 therapy within 28 days of first dose

plain.en: You have not had cancer immunotherapy in the last 4 weeks.
plain.es: No ha recibido inmunoterapia contra el cáncer en las últimas 4 semanas.

checks.sourceText: Pregnant or breastfeeding

plain.en: You are not pregnant or breastfeeding.

checks.sourceText: Known hypersensitivity to any excipient of the study drug per Investigator's Brochure

plain.en: Ask the study team about allergies to parts of the study medicine.
plain.es: Pregunte al equipo del estudio sobre alergias a componentes del medicamento.

title.en: A phone app for depression, in English and Spanish
title.es: Una aplicación de teléfono para la depresión, en inglés y español

summary.en: This study tests a phone app that teaches skills to manage low mood. You use it for 8 weeks from home. You can keep taking your usual medicines.
summary.es: Este estudio prueba una aplicación que enseña habilidades para manejar el ánimo bajo. La usa durante 8 semanas desde casa. Puede seguir tomando sus medicamentos habituales.

checks.sourceText: Aged 18-70

plain.en: You are 18 to 70 years old.

checks.sourceText: Current major depressive episode per DSM-5

plain.en: You have depression now.

checks.sourceText: Active suicidal ideation in the past 12 months

plain.en: You have not had thoughts of ending your life in the last year.
plain.es: No ha tenido pensamientos de quitarse la vida en el último año.

checks.sourceText: Current use of antipsychotic medication

plain.en: You do not take an antipsychotic medicine.

checks.sourceText: Owns a smartphone with internet access

plain.en: You have a smartphone with internet.
plain.es: Tiene un teléfono inteligente con internet.

title.en: A large study of several new COPD treatments
title.es: Un estudio grande de varios tratamientos nuevos para la EPOC

summary.en: This study tests several COPD medicines under one shared plan. The rules for who can join are in a separate document. Call the study team to learn more.
summary.es: Este estudio prueba varios medicamentos para la EPOC bajo un mismo plan. Las reglas para participar están en otro documento. Llame al equipo del estudio para saber más.

checks.sourceText: Age 40 to 85 years

plain.en: You are 40 to 85 years old.
